name: Mercy Falls on Deaf Ears
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
The Al'Aketh have visited great tragedy upon our enclave, and blood must be repaid with blood.

I have an offer for you, stranger. Should you find conflict with these accursed cultists, bring me the ears of those you kill. I will reward you for each that you return with in both coin and, in time, access to the Nightclaw's secrets should you prove yourself to be a true friend.
narrative.objectives: Collect 10 Al'Aketh Cultist's Ears from the Al'Aketh cultists in Shadowgale Forest, the Shine of Akir, or Gustberry Lowlands.
narrative.offerRewardText: Excellent work. Only good things can happen by eliminating the cult. Hopefully this sends a message that the Nightclaw are not to be trifled with and that our resentments run deep.I suspect you have your work cut out for yourself, taking on the cult. If you gather more ears bring them here.
narrative.requestItemsText: I will not rest until my fangs have gone through the throat of every single cultist on this isle.

mentionedItems.name: Al'Alketh Cultist's Ear
tooltip: "You can't help but wonder what the Nightclaw plan to do with all these ears."
